{
  "score": 7,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "unnecessary subshell forks in loop",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 3801,
      "message": "In the dispatch loop's stage:* resume arm, `_verdict_primary_output_path` and `_verdict_resolve_path` are called via `$()` subshells for every complete stage, even though the no-subshell `_v` variants (`_verdict_primary_output_path_v`, `_verdict_resolve_path_v`) exist for this exact purpose (ADR-065 §5); each complete stage forks two unnecessary subshells on the resume startup path.",
      "quote": "_du_prim_path=\"$(_verdict_primary_output_path \\\n                                    \"$_du_manifest\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n                                if [[ -n \"$_du_prim_path\" ]]; then\n                                    _du_resolved=\"$(_verdict_resolve_path \\\n                                        \"$_du_prim_path\" \"$state_dir\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "unnecessary subshell forks in loop",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1764,
      "message": "In `_runner_from_stage_preflight`, `_verdict_primary_output_path` and `_verdict_resolve_path` are called via `$()` for every pre-target stage, forking two subshells per stage when the `_v` variants would avoid all forks.",
      "quote": "_fsp_prim_path=\"$(_verdict_primary_output_path \"$_fsp_manifest\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n        [[ -z \"$_fsp_prim_path\" ]] && continue\n        _fsp_resolved=\"$(_verdict_resolve_path \"$_fsp_prim_path\" \"$_fsp_state_dir\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "redundant jq invocations per dispatch unit",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 3790,
      "message": "`get_state_field` calls `validate_json` (a `jq empty` fork) followed by a second `jq -r` fork on the same unchanged state file for every dispatch unit in resume mode; with N units, this forks 2N jq processes during resume startup before any stage runs.",
      "quote": "_du_stage_status=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" \\\n                            \".stage_statuses[\\\"$_ust\\\"]\" '' 2>/dev/null || true)\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "redundant jq invocations per cycle member",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 1444,
      "message": "On the first resumed iteration, up to four jq subprocesses are forked per complete cycle member (status read, verdict read, blob-entry construction, blob update); the state file and `$blob` could be read once before the member loop and updated in-memory instead.",
      "quote": "_cmbr_status=\"$(jq -r --arg s \"$s\" '.stage_statuses[$s] // \"pending\"' \\\n                \"$state_file\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"pending\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
